books.title: Unspeakable: The Tulsa Race Massacre
books.author: Carole Boston Weatherford 文 / Floyd Cooper 图
books.reason: 以图文重现塔尔萨种族大屠杀，沉重但必要的历史一课，建议家长陪同共读。
books.reason_en: The Tulsa Race Massacre in unflinching picture-book form — hard, essential history to read together.
books.source_name: ALA Caldecott 2022（银奖）

books.title: Wonder Walkers
books.author: Micha Archer 文/图
books.reason: 一路走一路问的自然之诗，云有脚吗式的提问点燃户外探索欲。
books.reason_en: Wonder-filled questions turn a walk into nature discovery — made for barefoot exploring.
books.source_name: ALA Caldecott 2022（银奖）

books.title: Hot Dog
books.author: Doug Salati 文/图
books.reason: 热到炸毛的小狗奔向海边降温，凯迪克金奖的夏日凉风，读着读着就凉快了。
books.reason_en: An overheated city pup dashes to the beach — a breezy Caldecott Medal summer escape.
books.source_name: ALA Caldecott 2023（金奖）

books.title: Ain't Burned All the Bright
books.author: Jason Reynolds 文 / Jason Griffin 图
books.reason: 诗、画与呼吸交织的当下黑人生活切片，艺术冲击力强，适合大童与家长共读。
books.reason_en: Poem, paint and breath braided into Black life in America now — striking art for older kids and parents.
books.source_name: ALA Caldecott 2023（银奖）

books.title: Berry Song
books.author: Michaela Goade 文/图
books.reason: 海岛采莓的四季之歌，祖孙与土地的馈赠往来，画面如极光般绚烂。
books.reason_en: A Tlingit girl and grandmother gather the island's gifts — luminous art about land and gratitude.
books.source_name: ALA Caldecott 2023（银奖）

books.title: Choosing Brave
books.author: Angela Joy 文 / Janelle Washington 图
books.reason: 民权之母马米·蒂尔以勇气直面丧子之痛，厚重传记，建议增设人文主题并家长共读。
books.reason_en: Mamie Till-Mobley's brave grief became a civil rights spark — sobering history, best read together.
books.source_name: ALA Caldecott 2023（银奖）

books.title: Knight Owl
books.author: Christopher Denise 文/图
books.reason: 小小猫头鹰圆梦当骑士，用机智化解危机，月光插画暖心，勇气与幽默兼备。
books.reason_en: A tiny owl knight outsmarts a dragon on night watch — cozy, funny and quietly brave.
books.source_name: ALA Caldecott 2023（银奖）

books.title: Big
books.author: Vashti Harrison 文/图
books.reason: 关于身材评价与自我接纳，2024凯迪克金奖，帮孩子抵御外界目光的伤害。
books.reason_en: A girl grows too big under others' words — the 2024 Medal book on body image and self-acceptance.
books.source_name: ALA Caldecott 2024（金奖）

books.title: In Every Life
books.author: Marla Frazee 文/图
books.reason: 爱与失去、惊奇与日常的两两对照，一句话一画面的生命礼赞，适合睡前慢读。
books.reason_en: Love and loss, wonder and routine, one luminous spread at a time — a quiet meditation on life.
books.source_name: ALA Caldecott 2024（银奖）

books.title: Jovita Wore Pants
books.author: Aida Salazar 文 / Molly Mendoza 图
books.reason: 女扮男装为自由而战的墨西哥女杰真实传记，勇气与性别平等启蒙，建议增设人文主题。
books.reason_en: The true story of Jovita, who wore pants to fight for her freedom — bold, inspiring biography.
books.source_name: ALA Caldecott 2024（银奖）

books.title: There Was a Party for Langston
books.author: Jason Reynolds 文 / Jerome & Jarrett Pumphrey 图
books.reason: 为诗人兰斯顿·休斯开一场字母派对，韵律如鼓点，文学启蒙首选，建议增设人文主题。
books.reason_en: An alphabet parade for poet Langston Hughes — language as drums, a joyful literary tribute.
books.source_name: ALA Caldecott 2024（银奖）

books.title: The Truth About Dragons
books.author: Julie Leung 文 / Hanna Cha 图
books.reason: 两位奶奶的睡前故事引出东西方龙的双重神话，文化交融的华丽画卷，建议增设人文主题。
books.reason_en: Bedtime stories lead a child into Eastern and Western dragon myths — ornate, culture-bridging art.
books.source_name: ALA Caldecott 2024（银奖）

books.title: Chooch Helped
books.author: Andrea L. Rogers 文 / Rebecca Lee Kunz 图
books.reason: 两岁弟弟帮倒忙引发的手足摩擦，切罗基文化底色，2025凯迪克金奖。
books.reason_en: Toddler Chooch helps with chaotic results — sibling patience wrapped in Cherokee culture, 2025 Medal book.
books.source_name: ALA Caldecott 2025（金奖）

books.title: My Daddy Is a Cowboy
books.author: Stephanie Seales 文 / C. G. Esperanza 图
books.reason: 黎明前与爸爸骑马穿城，牛仔故事与父女时光交织，节奏欢快的晨光共读。
books.reason_en: Before dawn, a girl and her father ride through the waking city — cowboy tales and precious time.
books.source_name: ALA Caldecott 2025（银奖）

books.title: Noodles on a Bicycle
books.author: Kyo Maclear 文 / Gracey Zhang 图
books.reason: 东京送面人的飞驰身手满页灵动，怀旧街景与节奏感，动作迷孩子的最爱。
books.reason_en: Demae deliverymen race through old Tokyo with steaming noodles — kinetic art full of motion and rhythm.
books.source_name: ALA Caldecott 2025（银奖）

books.title: Home in a Lunchbox
books.author: Cherry Mo 文/图
books.reason: 从香港初到美国的君用饭盒里的家乡味交到朋友，把移民孩子的孤单与适应写得细腻动人。
books.reason_en: Tastes of home ease her way into a new world.
books.source_name: ALA Caldecott 2025（银奖）

books.title: Up, Up, Ever Up! Junko Tabei
books.author: Anita Yasuda 文 / Yuko Shimizu 图
books.reason: 首位登顶珠峰的女性传记绘本，把'再试一次'的坚韧画得又美又有力量，给孩子的榜样书。
books.reason_en: The first woman atop Everest—grit and grace.
books.source_name: ALA Caldecott 2025（银奖）

books.title: Fireworks
books.author: Matthew Burgess 文 / Cátia Chien 图
books.reason: 夏夜姐弟出门等烟花的短短一夜，文字如诗、画面发光，把'期待'写给孩子看。
books.reason_en: Waiting for fireworks on a glowing summer night.
books.source_name: ALA Caldecott 2026（金奖）

books.title: Every Monday Mabel
books.author: Jashar Awan 文/图
books.reason: 小女孩每周一雷打不动守在窗前看垃圾车，孩子的'小痴迷'被写得真实可爱。
books.reason_en: Her weekly date with the garbage truck.
books.source_name: ALA Caldecott 2026（银奖）

books.title: Our Lake
books.author: Angie Kang 文/图
books.reason: 兄弟俩第一次没有爸爸陪伴重访湖边，用温柔安静的方式帮孩子谈论失去与想念。
books.reason_en: Brothers revisit a beloved lake without Dad.
books.source_name: ALA Caldecott 2026（银奖）

books.title: Stalactite & Stalagmite: A Big Tale from a Little Cave
books.author: Drew Beckmeyer 文/图
books.reason: 两块钟乳石见证亿万年地球变迁，把深奥的地质时间讲得幽默好懂，故事科普两不误。
books.reason_en: Two cave rocks watch world history unfold.
books.source_name: ALA Caldecott 2026（银奖）

books.title: Sundust
books.author: Zeke Peña 文/图
books.reason: 凯迪克银奖新作，沙漠里阳光统治一切的奇幻冒险，色彩炙热，想象力和美感都在线。
books.reason_en: A sun-drenched Caldecott Honor desert adventure.
books.source_name: ALA Caldecott 2026（银奖）

books.title: The Cat in the Hat
books.author: Dr. Seuss 文/图
books.reason: 雨天闯入的帽子猫制造混乱又收拾残局，韵文节奏感极强，英语自主阅读的经典第一课。
books.reason_en: Seussian rhymes—the classic first English reader.
books.source_name: Goodreads Listopia「Best Picture Books」

books.title: Madeline
books.author: Ludwig Bemelmans 文/图
books.reason: 巴黎寄宿学校里个子最小胆子最大的玛德琳，韵文朗朗上口，顺带带孩子游一遍巴黎。
books.reason_en: The smallest, bravest girl in Paris, in rhyme.
books.source_name: Goodreads Listopia「Best Picture Books」

books.title: Harold and the Purple Crayon
books.author: Crockett Johnson 文/图
books.reason: 睡前一支紫蜡笔画出月亮大海和回家的路，想象力的启蒙原点，怎么读都不腻。
books.reason_en: One purple crayon draws a whole world.
books.source_name: Goodreads Listopia「Best Picture Books」

books.title: Curious George
books.author: H. A. Rey & Margret Rey 文/图
books.reason: 好奇猴子被带上船又一路闯祸，80年经典形象，孩子在笑声里看到好奇心的两面。
books.reason_en: Eighty years of beloved monkey mischief.
books.source_name: Goodreads Listopia「Best Picture Books」

books.title: Tuesday
books.author: David Wiesner 文/图
books.reason: 周二夜里青蛙们乘荷叶飞过小镇，无字书的想象力天花板，每读一遍都有新发现。
books.reason_en: Frogs fly on lily pads—wordless wonder.
books.source_name: Goodreads Listopia「Best Picture Books」

books.title: The Search for the Giant Arctic Jellyfish
books.author: Chloe Savage 文/图
books.reason: 科学家远赴北冰洋寻找传说中的巨型水母，把科研的耐心与极地的神秘美讲给孩子。
books.reason_en: A patient Arctic quest for a legendary jellyfish.
books.source_name: The School Reading List (UK) Year 1

books.title: Don't Trust Fish!
books.author: Neil Sharpson 文 / Dan Santat 图
books.reason: 一本正经警告读者'千万别信鱼'，胡说八道里藏着真知识，笑点密集的爆笑科普向。
books.reason_en: A deadpan, fact-packed laugh about fish.
books.source_name: The School Reading List (UK) Year 1

books.title: The Midnight Panther
books.author: Poonam Mistry 文/图
books.reason: 没有斑点条纹和鬃毛的小黑豹，最终在星空下找到自己的光，印度纹样插画美极了。
books.reason_en: A shy panther finds his own light in mythic art.
books.source_name: The School Reading List (UK) Year 1

books.title: Goodnight Everyone
books.author: Chris Haughton 文/图
books.reason: 森林里大家都在打哈欠只有小熊不肯睡，色块浓郁的晚安书，睡前节奏刚刚好。
books.reason_en: The forest sleeps; one little bear resists.
books.source_name: The School Reading List (UK) Year 1

books.title: Hairy Maclary from Donaldson's Dairy
books.author: Lynley Dodd 文/图
books.reason: 毛毛狗麦克莱里呼朋引伴去遛弯，押韵节奏读起来像说唱，读几遍就能背的新西兰国宝。
books.reason_en: Dogs trot through town in irresistible rhyme.
books.source_name: The School Reading List (UK) Year 1

books.title: Cinnamon
books.author: Neil Gaiman 文 / Divya Srinivasan 图
books.reason: 不说话的公主遇见会讲故事的虎，尼尔·盖曼写的冷冽又温柔的寓言童话。
books.reason_en: Gaiman's fable of a mute princess and a tiger.
books.source_name: The School Reading List (UK) Year 1

books.title: That Rabbit Belongs to Emily Brown
books.author: Cressida Cowell 文 / Neal Layton 图
books.reason: 女王抢走艾米莉心爱的旧兔子，她偏不换，教孩子守护自己珍视的东西。
books.reason_en: Emily stands up to the Queen for her toy rabbit.
books.source_name: The School Reading List (UK) Year 1

books.title: The Smile Shop
books.author: Satoshi Kitamura 文/图
books.reason: 攒了一篮硬币想买个微笑的男孩发现，微笑不用买、可以送，温暖有哲思。
books.reason_en: Smiles can't be bought, only given—a warm parable.
books.source_name: The School Reading List (UK) Year 1

books.title: You Choose!
books.author: Pippa Goodhart 文 / Nick Sharratt 图
books.reason: 每页几百个选项随便组合编故事，亲子越聊越多，想象力和表达力一起练。
books.reason_en: Hundreds of choices to invent endless stories.
books.source_name: The School Reading List (UK) Year 1

books.title: The Bad-Tempered Ladybird
books.author: Eric Carle 文/图
books.reason: 坏脾气瓢虫见谁都想打架，最后学会交朋友，还顺带认识时间和动物体型大小。
books.reason_en: A grumpy ladybird learns friends matter more.
books.source_name: The School Reading List (UK) Year 1

books.title: King of the Classroom
books.author: Derrick Barnes 文 / Vanessa Brantley-Newton 图
books.reason: 上学第一天给自己加冕的自信宣言，把孩子'我能行'的气场写得让大人也想鼓掌。
books.reason_en: First-day-of-school confidence, crowned.
books.source_name: The School Reading List (UK) Year 1

books.title: Chocolate Cake
books.author: Michael Rosen 文 / Kevin Waldron 图
books.reason: 半夜溜下床偷吃蛋糕的名场面，迈克尔·罗森的声效叙事是亲子朗读的表演教科书。
books.reason_en: Rosen's midnight-cake performance—read-aloud gold.
books.source_name: The School Reading List (UK) Year 1
